expectations.text: States aggregate ownership counts: 30 plus 30 equals 60 percent, meeting the 50 percent threshold
expectations.evidence: "two listed parties holding 30 percent each add up to 60 percent, which is above the 50 percent threshold" and "30% + 30% = 60%, so the customer qualifies."

expectations.text: Explains the affiliate inherits the license requirements and policy of the listed parent or parents (most restrictive where multiple apply)
expectations.evidence: "the customer is subject to the Entity List license requirement of Supplement 4 to Part 744... normally reviewed under a presumption of denial, though the review policy in each owner's entry may differ. Check both entries."

expectations.text: Notes indirect ownership chains also count toward the threshold
expectations.evidence: "Indirect ownership counts, so a similar calculation applies if the 30 percent stakes are held through holding companies" and "Calculate aggregate ownership through every layer."

expectations.text: Correctly frames current status: not in effect until the stay lapses, currently extended to January 10, 2027
expectations.evidence: "has been stayed since November 10, 2025. The stay was extended by FR Doc 2026-22793 (effective November 9, 2026) to January 10, 2027... it resumes after January 10, 2027."

expectations.text: Recommends obtaining ownership information or certifications from counterparties and screening corporate family trees
expectations.evidence: "Confirm the ownership facts using documentary evidence (registry extracts, shareholder lists, certifications)... Update screening to calculate ownership and aggregate holdings."
